descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S01 「医院按每个字段搜索：姓名、房间、MRN、诊断」 Hospital search by each field: name, room, MRN, diagnosis

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Hospital: search by name, by room, by MRN and by diagnosis each returns the correct matching patients, each field on its own.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 2；TFA-92581 AC 5）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Fresh @roundai.test physician; one Hospital patient whose name, room, MRN or diagnosis holds a unique token (one test per field)

When Type part of the token in upper case with spaces around it, then a no-match string, then press Clear search

Then Only that patient is listed; the no-match string lists no patient and shows a no-match message; Clear empties the box and the patient is back

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions: token's patient visible and exactly one card; no card for the no-match string; search box empty and card visible after Clear (U1). Needs precondition P1

在哪跑：dev 上的 datasets（种数据集跑列表）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S01 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-03.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev，lane datasets（datasets/results.json，截图不附）。
